original_value: Samsung T5 Portable SSD features the latest Samsung V-NAND flash memory technology. With a compact, palm-sized metal body, it delivers transfer speeds of up to 540 MB/s, plus shock resistance and secure encryption for top-tier portable storage. Superfast read/write speeds of up to 540 MB/s. Metal construction from top to bottom, small enough to fit in your hand. Optional password protection and AES 256-bit hardware encryption. Comes with USB Type-C to C and USB Type-C to A cables. Shock resistant. 3-year warranty.
